_comment: Routine action kind `sessionTurn` (mchatai_macOS/docs/ROUTINES_ARCHITECTURE.md §3.3, §4.5). Behind feature flag routines_session_turn (default OFF) until R11 passes its gate. The prompt and grant are frozen at approval and hashed; fetched or relayed text can't widen the grant. A tool request outside the grant leaves the run blocked, then failed: blockedOnApproval after harness/routines/policy.json waits.approvalWaitMinutes. Never runs in bypass permission mode.
summary: Send a message to a conversation on a schedule.
help: Sends the same message to a Workbench conversation on each run, as if you had typed it, and waits for the reply. It can only use the tools you approved for it; anything else stops the run and asks you. If the conversation is busy it waits a while, then skips that run.

sessionID.title: Conversation
sessionID.description: "owner" means the conversation that owns the routine.

prompt.title: Message
prompt.description: Sent on every run. Stored as routine data, never as something you said.
